inclusion_rule: Speech or language decoders from EEG, MEG, ECoG, sEEG or intracortical recordings that perturb or remix real training recordings to enlarge or regularize the training set (additive noise, shifts and crops, masking or channel dropout, scaling, mixup, injection of artifact or reference-channel signals). Boundary: signals generated by a model from speech or text belong to M03/synthetic-biosignal-training-data and are excluded; augmenting only the audio or text target is excluded; artifact removal without re-injection is excluded; reviews remain as pattern matches (upper bound); versions of one study count once.
